page_title: LEC 2-1 CRE | Lecce v Cremonese 08/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Pointless reaction! Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) receives a red card for unsporting behaviour after the final whistle.
90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Sebastiano Luperto (Cremonese) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+6' Francesco Folino (Cremonese) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+6' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Cremonese for a penalty. Play continues.
90+5' A player from Lecce commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
90+3' Some neat passing and movement from Cremonese as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Lassana Coulibaly makes way for Sadik Fofana (Lecce).
88' The goal by Cremonese is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
86' Attention! Referee Simone Sozza straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible handball in the build-up.
85' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Simone Sozza due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Martin Payero (Cremonese) and his team.
82' The fouls committed statistics – 17:25.
78' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Lameck Banda is replaced by Omri Gandelman (Lecce).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Gaby Jean (Lecce) is replacing Santiago Pierotti.
77' Cremonese hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) comes onto the pitch for Giuseppe Pezzella.
73' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) jumps into a tackle and Simone Sozza signals a foul.
72' Lecce failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
71' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:7.
69' The corner from Lameck Banda (Lecce) is cleared away by the defence.
69' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
67' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
65' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Nikola Stulic will be replaced by Walid Cheddira (Lecce).
65' David Okereke (Cremonese) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
63' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) wins the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a shot which sails miles wide of the right post!
62' It will be a substitution. David Okereke (Cremonese) is ready to enter the pitch as Morten Thorsby walks off.
61' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
59' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.

58' Milan Djuric (Cremonese) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone pulls off a great save to deny him.
56' Martin Payero (Cremonese) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
56' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Lecce are awarded a free kick.
55' The percentage of ball possession is – 41:59.
53' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Milan Djuric (Cremonese) for his blatant foul.
51' Some great controlled play and passing from Cremonese. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
49' One of the Lecce players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
47' 2 - 1 Goal! Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Milan Djuric, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 2:1.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jari Vandeputte comes off for Martin Payero (Cremonese).
46' Half-time substitution. Jamie Vardy is replaced by Milan Djuric (Cremonese).
46' Davide Nicola makes a switch. Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is coming on in place of Matteo Bianchetti at the start of the second period.
46' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jamil Siebert (Lecce) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+3' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
45+1' Lameck Banda (Lecce) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
42' Cremonese are seeing far more of the ball now.
40' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:2.
38' 2 - 0 Goal! Nikola Stulic (Lecce) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Emil Audero to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
38' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
38' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Lecce!

37' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lecce.
36' Surely that's handball by one of the Cremonese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
35' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
33' Lecce are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
31' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Wladimiro Falcone makes a great save.
28' 2:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
26' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
24' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

22' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header into the top of the net. 1:0.
22' Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.
20' Lecce are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
18' Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
17' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
16' The resulting corner, taken by Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese), comes to nothing.
15' The ratio of the ball possession is 46:54.
13' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese). Simone Sozza saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
12' Cremonese are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
10' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
8' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

4' Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
2' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Lecce will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simone Sozza.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
